newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown holders approve options deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown holders approve options deal.

text.p: Crown Ltd shareholders on Monday approved amendments to the issue of options over 74.5 million shares to major shareholder Hudscon Conway Ltd.

A meeting of about 200 shareholders in the operator of the Melbourne casio voted on a show of hands to approve the changes, which bring forward the exercise date of the options and lower the exercise price to A$1.03 per share from A$1.15.
The new exercise date falls within a 14 day period starting from Monday.

Many of the dissenting shareholders expressed disappointment that Hudson Conway was being given an option over the shares at suxh a deep discount to the current market price, but Crown independent director John Utz said the lower exercise price reflected the bringing forward of the exercise date.
"The exercise price has been lowered to reflect the time value of money," Utz said.
